failure_summary.description: New constraints or requested domains were ignored, misapplied, or replaced with unrelated calls despite available conversation context and cache results.
Search and refinement results were not consistently bound to variables and saved to cache.
A round trip was searched as one outbound leg with both dates instead of separate outbound and reversed return searches.
A traveler count was passed to flight search although the schema does not support it.
Missing travel dates were invented rather than requested, while a fully specified restaurant request was also omitted.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly instructs agents to audit every outstanding request and new constraint, refine compatible cached results, separate flight legs, avoid unsupported arguments, save every result, and seek missing mandatory information. These failures therefore reflect noncompliance with existing guidance rather than a generalizable documentation gap; no edit is warranted.
